news.title: 'Total mess' - LaLiga club set for 70,000 World Cup stadium could be relegated
news.lede: That's according to European football journalists Kevin Hatchard and Andy Brassell as they sit winless at the bottom of Spain's top flight. After their 1-0 defeat to Sevilla on Friday night, Valencia have just one point to show for their efforts with five matches played in LaLiga. Carlos Corberan, formerly in charge of Championship side West Brom, has been sacked as head coach of his boyhood club amid their poor run. Ex-Chelsea chief Ron Gourlay has also been dismissed from his role as CEO of Football at Valencia, who were crowned Spanish champions in the 2003/04 season.

news.title: Westfield Resident To Represent U.S. In 2026 Transplant Football World Cup
news.lede: WESTFIELD, NJ — More than a decade after receiving a liver transplant, Westfield resident Matt Felix is set to represent the United States at the 2026 Transplant Football World Cup in Frankfurt, Germany. The tournament is scheduled for Sept. 13 to 18 and is hosted by the World Transplant Games Federation. It brings together transplant recipient athletes from around the world. Felix, a longtime advocate for NJ Sharing Network, said the trip is about more than soccer.

Bengaluru European football players’ union FIFPRO Europe demanded reforms to FIFA’s decision-making structures on Monday, arguing that the world body’s ​now-abandoned investment proposal exposed dangerous flaws in how global football is governed.

news.title: Fifpro demands review into Gianni Infantino’s failed World Cup sell-off plan
news.lede: Global players' union Fifpro has supported calls for an independent review of Fifa's governance following the backlash over a controversial World Cup private investment plan. Scrutiny remains on Fifa president Gianni Infantino over his management of the Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal. Under the scheme, private investors would have acquired a 20 per cent stake in a business managing commercial operations for Fifa events, including the men’s and women’s World Cups. The project was dropped following rejection by three continental confederations, including European governing body Uefa, which threatened to boycott Fifa tournaments unless the plan was scrapped and assurances provided that no similar attempt would recur.

news.title: Malagò: ‘Italy shouldn’t limit itself to World Cup qualification, Romano not the only one’
news.lede: FIGC President Giovanni Malagò insists that Italy should be aiming for more than just qualification to the next World Cup, that his predecessor Gabriele Gravina was right to resign after failing to qualify for the 2026 tournament, and has hinted that Alessandro Romano is not the only player considering switching nationalities to represent the Azzurri. Italy are preparing for their first international commitments of the 2026-27 season, with Nations League matches against Belgium, Turkiye, France and Turkiye again coming up in late September and early October. These matches will be the first under Malagò’s presidency. He was officially elected as the President of the Italian FA, a few months following the resignation of Gravina after Italy’s defeat to Bosnia and Herzegovina in the 2026 World Cup play-off final.

news.title: Carlo Ancelotti confirms Neymar's Brazil career is over as Selecao boss plots youth revolution after World Cup heartbreak
news.lede: Carlo Ancelotti has officially drawn the curtain on Neymar’s illustrious but often turbulent international career, confirming that the Santos forward will not return to the Brazil fold. Following the Selecao's disappointing exit at the last World Cup, the Italian tactician is now pivoting toward an aggressive youth movement designed to reshape the five-time world champions. In a bombshell announcement that signals the definitive end of an era, Ancelotti has confirmed that Neymar will no longer represent the Selecao on the international stage. The Italian tactician revealed that the decision was made by the player himself, ending months of speculation regarding his future following the 2026 World Cup.

news.title: When is the England squad announced? Thomas Tuchel to name team for first time since World Cup heartbreak
news.lede: After seeing their wait for major silverware continue with a gut-wrenching semi-final defeat to Argentina this summer, the Three Lions return in a bumper first international break of the season. In a major shake-up, FIFA announced earlier this year that the September and October international breaks would merge from the start of the 2026/27 campaign. Thomas Tuchel's side will now play four matches across two weeks as opposed to the traditional two matches in a week format. And England face some stern tests, as they gear up to face world champions Spain, Croatia and Czechia twice in the Nations League.
